rationale: Dance with Me verified on Heartstopper S1E2 soundtrack by NME and Capital; Wikipedia confirms the original 2018 single (Patched Up EP), so both the Heartstopper row and the single row are legitimate. Could not match 'Heartstopper: Official Mixtape' to an officially cataloged album (official album release is the Adiescar Chase score; songs live on Spotify's 'Official Playlist'), so the release name itself is only medium confidence.
